postings.title: ABM & Marketing Executive
postings.description:
Reporting to: UK General Manager
Location: London / UK hybrid or remote
Level: Junior / Early career



ABOUT US

We are a clinical AI company with a clear mission: using evidence-based clinical AI to make quality mental healthcare accessible to everyone, everywhere.

We believe technology can play a meaningful role in improving access to mental healthcare, reducing pressure on overstretched services, and supporting better outcomes for patients - but only when it is built responsibly, grounded in evidence, and designed around the realities of care delivery.

Our work in the UK is focused on supporting NHS Talking Therapies and wider mental health services. As a small, ambitious team, we are helping drive real change in how mental healthcare is delivered across the UK.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for an ABM & Marketing Executive to help grow our presence across the UK mental health market.

This is a junior but high-impact marketing role with a strong focus on account-based marketing, supporting targeted engagement with priority accounts across NHS Talking Therapies and wider mental health services. You will work closely with the UK General Manager to help shape and implement strategies for key accounts, identify the right organisations and stakeholders, and improve how we engage the market.

Alongside ABM activity, you will also support broader marketing initiatives across content, campaigns, webinars, events, CRM, and day-to-day execution. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants high autonomy, real responsibility, and the chance to learn fast inside a mission-driven AI company. You should be excited by the opportunity to test ideas, take ownership, and embrace the latest AI marketing tools to help us build a smarter, more modern marketing engine.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

· Support the planning and delivery of account-based marketing activity across priority UK accounts

· Research target organisations, services, and stakeholders to help build account plans, contact lists, and engagement strategies

· Help shape, set up, and implement targeted engagement strategies for priority accounts

· Coordinate tailored outreach and campaign activity across channels including email, LinkedIn, webinars, events, and follow-up communications

· Work closely with the UK General Manager and wider team to ensure account engagement is well organised, relevant, and timely

· Support the execution of broader UK marketing campaigns and initiatives

· Help create and adapt marketing assets including one-pagers, case studies, email copy, social content, event materials, and presentations

· Use the latest AI marketing tools to improve research, content creation, campaign execution, and productivity, while maintaining high standards of quality and accuracy

· Maintain CRM and campaign data, support audience segmentation, and help track engagement and performance

· Assist with webinars, roundtables, conferences, and other market-facing activity

· Contribute to market research, campaign reporting, and day-to-day marketing coordination

· Take ownership of projects and deliver them with a high degree of autonomy



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

· 1-3 years of experience in a marketing role, internship, graduate programme, or similar commercial environment

· A strong interest in B2B marketing, with enthusiasm for account-based marketing and targeted campaign execution

· Excitement about using the latest AI tools to work smarter, test ideas faster, and improve marketing effectiveness

· Excellent written communication skills and strong attention to detail

· Good organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities

· A proactive, hands-on approach and willingness to support across a range of marketing activities

· Comfort with autonomy, ownership, and a fast-moving startup environment

· Confidence working with different stakeholders in a collaborative, high-trust team

· Genuine interest in healthcare, mental health, and the role AI can play in improving access and quality of care



DESIRABLE EXPERIENCE

· Exposure to HubSpot or another CRM / marketing automation platform

· Experience supporting campaigns, events, webinars, email marketing, or content development

· Experience using AI tools to support research, content, workflow, or campaign execution

· Experience in B2B SaaS, healthtech, or another complex or regulated market

· Familiarity with the NHS, mental health services, or public-sector audiences

· Interest in AI, digital health, or innovation in healthcare



WHY JOIN US

This is an opportunity to join a mission-driven AI company working on one of the most important challenges in healthcare today.

You will be part of a small UK team with the chance to make a visible impact from day one. This role offers a rare combination of autonomy, responsibility, and growth: you will not just support someone else's strategy, you will help shape and implement your own.

You will gain hands-on experience in account-based marketing while building broad marketing skills across campaigns, content, events, and market development. You will work closely with senior leadership in the UK, use the latest AI marketing tools in practice, and play a role in helping change the way mental healthcare is delivered across the country.

We are looking for someone who is excited by the craft of marketing and who feels strongly about our mission: using evidence-based AI to make quality mental healthcare accessible to everyone, everywhere.

postings.title: AI/ML Engineer
postings.description:
Build the AI therapist that delivers end-to-end CBT to patients in the US: live, clinically supervised, and measured on whether people actually get better.

About Limbic

Limbic’s vision is to ensure the highest quality therapy is accessible to everyone, everywhere.

Limbic has supported more than 820,000 patients across the UK and the US. We are used in over 50% of NHS Talking Therapies services, which makes us the largest-ever deployment of generative AI for direct patient care, and our AI now delivers end-to-end therapy to patients in the US under the supervision of licensed clinicians.

Safety and science come first. We are the only AI mental health chatbot with UKCA Class IIa medical device certification, and the first AI-led mental healthcare company selected for the FDA’s TEMPO pilot. Our results are published in leading scientific journals: in a randomised, double-blind trial published in Nature Medicine, our AI agents scored higher than licensed CBT therapists on a standard measure of therapy skill.

The Role

As an AI/ML Engineer, you will sit at the intersection of computational psychiatry, clinical science, and software engineering. You will join the product team building our AI therapist: a voice agent that delivers structured, evidence-based CBT over the phone to adults with depression and anxiety, with licensed clinicians overseeing every patient’s care.

The product is live and growing week on week, so your work reaches real patients quickly. You will own problems end to end: frame them with clinicians and product managers, ship a change, measure whether it helped, and iterate. Our AI products are built on shared platforms for agents, evaluation and safety, so what you build here is reused across Limbic.

What You’ll Do

 - Improve how our AI therapist runs sessions, from session structure and case formulation to therapeutic techniques and continuity across a course of treatment, working closely with clinicians.

 - Strengthen the safety systems that protect patients in real time, including risk detection and how the agent responds when risk is disclosed.

 - Build evaluations and LLM-as-judge autolabellers, validated against clinician labels, so we know quickly and reliably whether a change made care better or worse.

 - Make voice conversations feel natural: responsive, well-paced, and able to recover gracefully when a conversation goes off script.

 - Help patients stay with their treatment long enough to recover, through AI features such as well-timed session reminders and clear expectations about what therapy involves, and test what works with experiments.

 - Optimise how we collect outcome measures such as PHQ-9 and GAD-7, including the methods, timing and predictive modelling of recovery.

 - Ship changes safely through incremental rollouts, automated testing and a clinical sign-off process built for a regulated medical device.

What You’ll Bring

 - You must meet one of the following educational and experience backgrounds:
   
   - A PhD in Computational Psychiatry or a related field, coupled with demonstrated industry experience in Data Science, Product, or ML engineering.
   
   - OR A BSc/MSc in a Computational Psychiatry related field (research focus) plus 2 years of experience in ML engineering or Data Science within an Engineering/Product Development environment.

 - Proficiency in either Python or TypeScript/JavaScript.

 - Experience building LLM-powered features and a track record of eval-driven development.

 - An expert approach to hypothesis-driven work, with a track record of balancing product development with scientific rigour.

 - Experience using Machine Learning in a production environment or via high-impact scientific publications (e.g., predictive modelling, reinforcement learning).

 - Experience modelling text/language data, including building LLM classifiers and using vector-based methods.

 - Experience modelling longitudinal data and working with databases (SQL or NoSQL).

 - A strong understanding of evidence-based mental health care (such as Cognitive Behavioural Therapy) and a deep interest in the causal mechanisms that drive therapeutic benefit.

 - A bias to action: you break big problems into pieces you can ship within a week, and you are comfortable making decisions with incomplete information.

 - Proficiency with version control systems, preferably Git.

 - Ideal but not required: Experience building an LLM agent harness or real-time voice AI.

 - The ability to work from our London (Spitalfields) office on Tuesdays and Thursdays, with the flexibility to work remotely or from the office on other days of the week.

Benefits & Wellbeing

 - Competitive salary and equity share options.

 - An amazing office in central London (Spitalfields) for our collaborative team days on Tuesdays and Thursdays, paired with a flexible/hybrid working model on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays.

 - 25 days PTO plus bank holidays.

 - Company pension scheme (UK).

 - Enhanced parental leave packages (UK).

 - Support with purchasing work-related books and materials.

 - Quarterly Life Days: Enjoy 4 paid days off per year (one each quarter) to use whenever you choose to relax, recharge, or take care of personal matters.

 - Mental Health Support: Access to dedicated mental health support services.

We encourage women and individuals from diverse backgrounds to apply and join our team. We believe in creating an inclusive and supportive work environment where everyone can contribute their best.

postings.title: Senior AI/ML Engineer
postings.description:
Take ownership of the AI behind our clinical products in the US: an AI therapist delivering end-to-end care, and AI assessment used by healthcare providers.

About Limbic

Limbic’s vision is to ensure the highest quality therapy is accessible to everyone, everywhere.

Limbic has supported more than 820,000 patients across the UK and the US. We are used in over 50% of NHS Talking Therapies services, which makes us the largest-ever deployment of generative AI for direct patient care, and our AI now delivers end-to-end therapy to patients in the US under the supervision of licensed clinicians.

Safety and science come first. We are the only AI mental health chatbot with UKCA Class IIa medical device certification, and the first AI-led mental healthcare company selected for the FDA’s TEMPO pilot. Our results are published in leading scientific journals: in a randomised, double-blind trial published in Nature Medicine, our AI agents scored higher than licensed CBT therapists on a standard measure of therapy skill.

The Role

As a Senior AI/ML Engineer, you have demonstrated experience in AI product development and will take ownership of translating AI research into products that tangibly improve patients’ lives. You will join one of our two product teams building for the US market, and we will work with you to find the one where your strengths have the most impact:

 - AI therapy: a voice agent delivering structured CBT over the phone to adults with depression and anxiety, with licensed clinicians overseeing care. It is live with Medicare patients and growing every week.

 - AI assessment: a conversational agent that US healthcare organisations configure to assess patients, administer clinical questionnaires, detect risk and recommend the right treatment programme, so patients reach the right care faster.

Both teams build on shared platforms for agents, evaluation and safety, so the systems you design are reused across the company, and you will be expected to bring your successes cross-product.

What You’ll Do

 - Own the AI quality of a live clinical product end to end, from framing problems with clinicians and product managers to shipping, monitoring and improving in production.

 - Design and build agentic systems, including orchestration of specialised agents, tools and memory, that stay fast enough for real-time voice and text conversations.

 - Build and improve the safety systems that screen every patient message and every AI reply, from real-time risk detection to guardrails against unsafe or clinically inappropriate responses.

 - Lead eval-driven development: evaluation suites, simulated patients and LLM-as-judge autolabellers validated against clinician labels, so we ship with confidence and catch regressions before patients do.

 - Productionise ML models that optimise product KPIs, such as triage accuracy, treatment completion and recovery rates, and identify the causal factors that drive them.

 - Help turn our clinical AI into composable services that healthcare partners can integrate into their own patient journeys.

 - Raise the engineering bar through architecture, code review and mentorship, while keeping our AI continuously compliant with strict regulatory requirements.

What You’ll Bring

 - You must meet one of the following educational and experience backgrounds:
   
   - A PhD in computational science or an AI-related field, plus 2 years of experience in an ML engineering role.
   
   - OR A BSc/MSc, plus 4 years of experience in an ML engineering role.

 - Expertise in productising LLM features and a strong background in eval-driven development.

 - Expert-level proficiency in Python and TypeScript/JavaScript.

 - Proven experience building an LLM agent harness.

 - Experience utilising reinforcement learning.

 - Strong architectural skills with experience designing scalable, production-grade systems for machine learning applications.

 - A solid understanding of statistical principles in the context of LLM evaluation and user activity analytics.

 - Proficiency with version control systems (preferably Git) and databases (SQL or NoSQL).

 - Hands-on experience with a major cloud platform and containerisation technologies.

 - A track record of end-to-end ownership: you scope work you can ship quickly, measure its impact, and keep a sense of urgency when the stakes are high.

 - A genuine interest in applying your technical skills to solve complex challenges in the mental healthcare space.

 - Ideal but not required: Experience with real-time voice AI, or with healthcare organisations as customers.

 - The ability to work from our London (Spitalfields) office on Tuesdays and Thursdays, with the flexibility to work remotely or from the office on other days of the week. As you will work on products for the US, expect some meetings in the late afternoon UK time.

 - We can consider visa sponsorship for candidates relocating to London.

Benefits & Wellbeing

 - Competitive salary and equity share options.

 - An amazing office in central London (Spitalfields) for our collaborative team days on Tuesdays and Thursdays, paired with a flexible/hybrid working model on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays.

 - 25 days PTO plus bank holidays.

 - Company pension scheme (UK).

 - Enhanced parental leave packages (UK).

 - Support with purchasing work-related books and materials.

 - Quarterly Life Days: Enjoy 4 paid days off per year (one each quarter) to use whenever you choose to relax, recharge, or take care of personal matters.

 - Mental Health Support: Access to dedicated mental health support services.

We encourage women and individuals from diverse backgrounds to apply and join our team. We believe in creating an inclusive and supportive work environment where everyone can contribute their best.

postings.title: Product Manager
postings.description:
PRODUCT MANAGER - LIMBIC ACCESS

Limbic builds AI-powered mental healthcare. Our front-door Access product talks to thousands of patients a month across the NHS and major US health systems. Access is past 0→1 in the UK and US: the product exists, customers are live, the model is proven. We're hiring a Product Manager to take it 1→10 in the US, against a growing pipeline of enterprise customers, owning the team's day-to-day product cadence. The job is to ship and ship well.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN

You'll own the week-to-week rhythm that turns engineering into shipped product:

 - Run the team's ceremonies: effective, alignment-creating, always followed up on.

 - Own roadmap prioritisation. Understand the projects in play, weigh their relative impact, and sequence them. Ground the sequencing in customer signal, and user feedback, usage, and behaviour.

 - Triage the inbound: bugs, debt, CS asks, scope additions. Separate real issues from noise, route to the right owner, decide what gets iterated when.

 - Scope and define the work. Write project overviews the team can act on, ensuring the next-highest-value project is always lined up.

 - Own the incident loop. Triage, root cause, fix, follow-up. Engineers get space to fix; you hold the loop.

 - Keep the product well instrumented. Mixpanel today and whatever's next. Ensure the team can answer its own questions from the data, and that you can read user behavior out of it.

 - Protect engineering focus. Hold the line on scope creep from any sources. Check in 1:1 mid-cycle with anyone who's blocked or drifting.
   
   


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You've shipped product before. Maybe one or two roles in. You want real product management. The kind where you own outcomes, not Jira tickets.

 - You ship features and projects that move metrics and create outcomes. Not work that's about looking good.

 - Comfortable with engineers and engineering concepts. You build strong mental models for how products work and apply them in your day-to-day.

 - You write clearly and quickly. You think clearly from first principles.

 - You think critically with data. You can pull insights yourself, interrogate how they were generated, and reason about what they actually mean. Not 'I made a decision with data once.'

 - You never produce AI slop, but you do heavily rely on AI in your day-to-day. You go beyond using AI to write PRDs.

 - You are 'client safe' - you can represent Limbic to customers professionally.

 - You can say no to someone and make them feel it's in their best interest.

 - You build products. You know the difference between a feature that creates repeatable value and a one-off that introduces drag and tech debt.

 - Healthcare experience is a bonus, but not a requirement. EHR integration and working knowledge of health-data standards (HL7, FHIR) especially.

You won't fit if you need polished process, a heavy spec phase, or a team that loves meetings. We're ahead of our process.




WHY THIS ROLE

Two things to know.

One. It's a delivery role for now, with a clear set of projects to execute on (but prioritize and sequence effectively). You'll grow into more strategic scope over the next 4-6 months. The immediate brief is to make the engineering team's product cadence quieter and more predictable.

Two. The team is small and load is high. The hire exists because we need to free senior product time for discovery and strategy on a separate product. You might feel the pressure of that. In return: real customers (millions of lives) and the opportunity to iterate the product in a company-defining direction.




PRACTICAL

 - Level: APM / Mid Product Manager

 - Location: East Coast USA

postings.title: Technical Implementation Manager
postings.description:
ABOUT LIMBIC

Limbic is the leading clinical AI company for mental healthcare and the world's largest deployment of patient-facing mental health AI. Our technology has supported over half a million patients across the UK and US, helping health systems deliver higher-quality, more accessible, and more efficient care.

We regulated the first AI diagnostic model for adult mental health as a Class IIa medical device. We've published in top-tier journals, won major awards, and advise governments and regulators globally on AI safety, medical devices, and the future of clinical agentic systems.

For a Customer Success professional, this means joining a team at the forefront of transforming behavioral-health access — where your relationships, insights, and execution directly influence how health systems adopt AI, improve workflows, and unlock measurable value for patients and clinicians.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Limbic is looking for a Technical Implementation Manager to lead the onboarding and go-live process for new health system, payer, and payvider partners. You'll be the primary point of contact from contract signature through launch and early adoption — translating clinical workflows, technical requirements, and compliance needs into a smooth, on-time implementation. This is a hands-on, cross-functional role that sits at the intersection of clinical operations, technical delivery, AI agent configuration, and partner relationship management.

This role requires genuine technical fluency, not just project coordination. You'll be diagnosing integration failures, data mapping issues, and configuration problems in real time, and know exactly which team needs to solve them. When something breaks mid-implementation, you're expected to understand what happened and why before you escalate — not simply relay a symptom and wait for someone else to translate it.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own end-to-end implementation for new partners — from kickoff through launch and early post-go-live support

 - Diagnose root cause when implementations break — distinguishing between a data mapping issue, config error, API/integration failure, or product gap — and route it to the right team

 - Read logs, API responses, and system behavior well enough to hold a credible, detailed technical conversation with engineering — not just relay a symptom and wait for someone else to translate it

 - Lead complex, multi-stakeholder technical conversations directly with partner IT, engineering teams, and EHR vendors, including when the failure mode isn't obvious

 - Write and run scripts or queries (e.g., SQL, Python) to test, validate, or troubleshoot integration and configuration issues before escalating

 - Own the technical relationship with partner engineering teams directly — you're the primary technical point of contact, not a relay to our engineers

 - Configure and tune Limbic's AI agents to each partner's clinical protocols, routing logic, and population needs

 - Serve as the primary partner-facing contact — take a consultative approach, helping shape the right solution rather than just executing a spec

 - Translate complex technical and clinical concepts into plain language partners can act on

 - Lead training and rollout for partner teams, ensuring smooth adoption after go-live

 - Favor rapid deployment and iteration — get a working version live, gather real signal, and improve from there

 - Partner closely with Product and Engineering on recurring gaps, helping shape fixes rather than re-solving the same issue manually each time

 - Build and maintain playbooks for repeatable, scalable implementation and agent-configuration processes


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 5+ years in technical implementation, integration engineering, or solutions consulting — healthcare, health tech, or B2B SaaS preferred

 - Strong technical troubleshooting instincts — comfortable in API docs, logs, and system architecture, not just spreadsheets and timelines

 - Ability to write and run scripts or queries (SQL, Python, or similar) to test integrations or debug independently

 - A track record of being the technical bridge between engineering/product and external partners

 - Comfort holding a debugging conversation directly with a partner's engineers, without needing one of our engineers on every call

 - Ability to explain complex technical or clinical ideas in plain, simple language

 - A consultative, solutions-oriented communication style — comfortable proposing and persuading, not just taking orders

 - A QA mindset — comfortable writing test cases and validating systems before they touch real users

 - Strong project management instincts — you build the plan, not just follow one

 - A "ship it, then improve it" mentality — you'd rather get something live fast and iterate than stall chasing perfection

 - Bias toward action and comfort with ambiguity — healthcare implementations rarely go exactly to plan

 - Experience with behavioral health, payer, or ACO/value-based care environments

 - Familiarity with FHIR APIs, EHR systems (Epic, Cerner), or healthcare data interoperability

 - Experience working with major national payers, payviders, or large health systems

postings.title: Clinical Transcript Reviewer
postings.description:
CLINICAL TRANSCRIPT REVIEWER

Please note that this is a rolling advert, and we have reached capacity on our current reviewer group. You are welcome to apply, and we will be in contact when we start the next recruitment round (TBC  2026-27). 

 


ABOUT LIMBIC

Limbic is the leading clinical AI company for mental healthcare and the largest deployment of patient-facing mental health AI in the world. Our technology has supported over half a million patients across the UK and US, helping health systems deliver higher-quality, more accessible, and more efficient care.

We regulated the first AI diagnostic model for adult mental health as a Class IIa medical device. We’ve published in top-tier journals, won major awards, and advise governments and regulators globally on AI safety, medical devices, and the future of clinical agentic systems.

We now want to focus on providing direct-to-patient best in class AI-led care, and are recruiting to staff our exciting and progressive care clinic.

 


BRIEF JOB DESCRIPTION:

We are seeking experienced US-licensed Psychotherapists or Psychologists to review transcripts of calls between our patients and our AI therapy agents. Your reviews will directly shape how we support real people seeking care; flagging risk, ensuring clinical appropriateness, and defining what "genuinely helpful" looks like at scale.

This is flexible, remote, contract work well-suited to a licensed clinician who wants meaningful part-time work at the frontier of mental health care.

 


CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Review conversation transcripts against clinical quality, accuracy, and safety standards

 - Identify and flag clinical risk, safety concerns, and moments requiring human clinical judgment

 - Assess whether responses are clinically appropriate, empathetic, and aligned with best practice

 - Document clear, structured feedback that our clinical and product teams can act on

 - Note: this role does not involve direct patient contact or care delivery. Any concerns are flagged to Limbic employed clinicians for further action. 
   
    


WHO WE NEED

 - Active, unrestricted clinical license (e.g., LCSW, LPC, LMFT, LMHC, PsyD, or equivalent) in at least one US state. Multiple licenses or PSYPACT are a plus but not essential

 - US-based

 - Strong clinical judgment with experience in direct mental health care

 - Experience assessing risk and safety in a clinical setting

 - Excellent attention to detail and clear written communication

 - Comfortable working independently on a flexible, remote schedule

 - Reliable computer and internet access
   
    


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Flexible 1099 independent contractor engagement

 - Fully remote

 - Flexible hours

 - No minimum or maximum hourly commitment

 - Compensation at a rate of $3 per transcript reviewed (time to review transcripts is based on conversation length and therefore fluctuates. Some transcripts take < 1 minute to review, some may take up to 5 minutes). 

 - The opportunity to work alongside experts in their fields in a world-leading AI company

 - A chance to shape the future of mental health technology and AI safety protocols

 - An inclusive, collaborative, supportive working environment, where you will have direct access to clinical support and supervision at all times (within working hours)

postings.title: Senior Full-stack Engineer
postings.description:
DESCRIPTION

Limbic's vision is to ensure the highest quality therapy is accessible to everyone, everywhere. The way we do that is by deploying AI responsibly, using it to augment clinical care and reduce barriers to accessing therapy at scale. Limbic is already used extensively in Talking Therapies in the UK, and now expanding operations in the US market.

Every day, thousands of patients already interact with Limbic, making therapy more accessible. Limbic goes beyond replacing existing processes with AI and helps people recover from their mental health challenges who otherwise would not have.

We're seeking a Senior Full-stack Engineer who's motivated by seeing their work change outcomes for real people. You'll ship features end-to-end that patients and clinicians depend on every day — and you'll be expected to care about why you're building something, not just how. If you've ever pushed back on a ticket because you didn't think it served users, or shipped something and then chased down the data to see if it actually worked, this is your kind of team.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design, build, and ship full-stack features end-to-end, including:
   
   - Implementing TypeScript/Node.js backend services compliant with data residency and regulatory standards
   
   - Building React user interfaces for both patient-facing and clinician-facing products
   
   - Modeling and handling application data (MongoDB, PostgreSQL) using regulatory compliance best practices

 - Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering standards

 - Triage incoming alerts for collaborative error monitoring

 - Participate in periodic "SideQuest" hackathon days
   
    

We encourage women and individuals from diverse backgrounds to apply and join our team. We believe in creating an inclusive and supportive work environment where everyone can contribute their best.

 


REQUIREMENTS

 - 4+ years of professional full-stack engineering experience

 - North American business hours (Eastern time preferred, for better European overlap). Maintain daily overlap with colleagues in Europe (UTC to UTC+3).

 - Limbic cannot provide visa sponsorship

 - A track record of shipping features with measurable user impact — you can tell us what you built, why it mattered, and how you knew it worked

 - Strong TypeScript and Node.js ability (GraphQL and tRPC familiarity preferred)

 - Solid React experience building production web applications

 - Experience with databases — should be comfortable with PostgreSQL as well as document databases and KV stores

 - Experience with React Native is a bonus
   
    


BENEFITS

 - 25 days PTO (Canada)

 - Equity share options

 - Support with purchasing work-related books and materials

We take employee wellbeing seriously at Limbic and in addition to the above we offer:

 - Quarterly life days (Enjoy 4 paid days off per year to use whenever you choose - one each quarter - to relax, recharge, or take care of personal matters)

 - Access to mental health support
